test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct active form.

"The article ought to have been revised by the editor."

options.text: The editor ought to have revised the article.
The editor ought to be revising the article.
The editor ought to revise the article.
The editor must have revised the article.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the passive voice, the sentence is: "The article ought to have been revised by the editor."
 
• To convert to active voice: Place the subject "the editor" at the beginning.
 
• Change the passive verb form "ought to have been revised" to "ought to have revised" (active voice structure).
 
• Ensure the object "the article" remains at the end of the sentence for clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The editor ought to have revised the article."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: **"The editor ought to be revising the article." – This implies an ongoing action, which is incorrect for the sentence structure.
 
• **Option 3: **"The editor ought to revise the article." – This implies a suggestion for future action, which is incorrect here.
 
• **Option 4: **"The editor must have revised the article." – This implies certainty about a past action, which is different in meaning.
